title: orkcraft building UI document
description: How a building's window is laid out: panes of components, split in rows and columns. Roles only: fonts, tones and components are names from the design system (docs/design-system.md), never raw colours, font names or code. Which panes a building has, and which components each may wear, is its type's contract (orkcraft/design/buildings/).

type.description: The building type whose contract this follows.

note.description: Why it looks like this, in a sentence (who changed it and why).

split.description: column: one under another; row: side by side.

size.description: auto: as tall (or wide) as its content; 1-12: a share of the room left.

id.description: A pane of the type's contract.

component.description: One of the components the contract allows for this pane.

title.description: The pane's heading on its frame; empty: none.

hidden.description: Not shown (never for a required pane).
